facts.fact: 1a 那夜全部塌了，一楼地板烂穿，整栋湿透长满霉与地衣
facts.anchor: The whole of 1a had come down that night, collapsed like a diseased ribcage over desiccated lungs.

facts.fact: 勘测员说从外面能一直看到地下室；下面什么都没有，只有磨损发黑的“孤独的老石头”
facts.anchor: Just lonely old stones, worn and blackened with age.

facts.fact: 她问地下室那扇门，对方含糊说所有门都毁了，她猜自己永远不会知道
facts.anchor: she said something about all doors being completely destroyed

facts.fact: 中介用的是“房产牛仔”签字的旧勘测、根本没人到现场；他们赔了一张支票，够她过一两年
facts.anchor: never actually making their way out to survey the place at all

facts.fact: Fergus 拉她逛古董市集、后备箱集市，她买回旧家具；她说这一仗她乐意停战
facts.anchor: This was one battle on which I was happy to call a truce.

facts.fact: 工人拆房把石头码在一边，说石头还好，只需放回正确位置、配上正确支撑
facts.anchor: They just needed to be put back in the right place, with the right support.

facts.fact: 她跟 Rowan 去他的愤怒小组（Fergus 戏称 Angerholics Anonymous），也上线上情绪管理课
回到 Carlinsrest，Maggie 用对熟客的抬眉招呼她、给她通心粉派；她与那少年隔街对嚎
facts.anchor: We howled together until someone inside the pub yelled for someone to see to their dog.
